hooks.command: cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" || exit 0; cmd=$(jq -r ".tool_input.command // empty"); printf "%s\n" "$cmd" | grep -Eq "(^|[;&|]) *git( +-C +[^ ]+)? +push( |$)" || exit 0; if printf "%s\n" "$cmd" | grep -Eq "push.*[ :+](refs/heads/)?main( |$)|--all|--mirror" || [ "$(git branch --show-current)" = main ]; then echo "Pushing to main directly is not allowed. Push a branch and open a pull request instead." >&2; exit 2; fi

cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" || exit 0; jq -e ".stop_hook_active == true" >/dev/null 2>&1 && exit 0; out=$(uv run --quiet ruff check --output-format concise . 2>&1) || { printf "ruff check found violations. Fix them before finishing:\n%s\n" "$out" >&2; exit 2; }

cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" || exit 0; jq -e ".stop_hook_active == true" >/dev/null 2>&1 && exit 0; out=$(uv run --quiet ty check --output-format concise 2>&1) || { printf "ty check found type errors. Fix them before finishing:\n%s\n" "$out" >&2; exit 2; }

cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" || exit 0; [ -f tach.toml ] || exit 0; jq -e ".stop_hook_active == true" >/dev/null 2>&1 && exit 0; out=$( { uv run --quiet tach check && uv run --quiet tach check-external; } 2>&1) || { printf "tach found module boundary violations. Fix them before finishing:\n%s\n" "$out" >&2; exit 2; }
